_comment: Declarative description of the input datasets FIREWALL's test pipeline needs.
Each entry is resolved through the Zenodo REST API by scripts/fetch_data.py.
Every logical dataset is a separate entry so that it can be repointed at a
different Zenodo record without touching any code. In particular the ITER

resources.name: iter-wall
resources.description: ITER first-wall triangular surface mesh, offset 10 cm.
resources.provenance: Full-torus triangular surface mesh of the ITER first wall, offset 10 cm: 962939 triangles, R 3.877-8.584 m, Z -3.305-4.827 m. This is the JOREK wall triangulation; the particle file indexes it directly (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md). Distributed inside the shared J2_data.zip archive.
resources.rights_holder: ITER Organization (geometry); record published by V. J. Svensson under CC-BY-4.0

resources.name: jorek-particles
resources.description: Runaway-electron marker output from a JOREK J2 simulation (wall strike points, energies, incidence angles).
resources.provenance: JOREK runaway-electron simulation, case J2: 1000000 markers, with the strike element index (i_elm) and the barycentric position within that element (st).

resources.name: deposition-maps
resources.description: Monte-Carlo energy-deposition maps in tungsten versus incident energy and angle, used to build the interpolation table.
